scope: Static first-connection recipient certificates on the same retained Earth-radius reference. No seasonal advancement, water transfer, active frontier, receiving capacity/backpressure, hydraulic routing, allocation, merge, or new checkpoint.

verification.generatedGeometryControls: Three seeds: adjacency, exact sill interiors, receiver-edge descent, actual terminal/body ownership and unchanged hierarchy/drainage.
verification.syntheticControls: Three-way chain with unfilled middle, unresolved alternatives, nested receiving entry, actual noncanonical wet contact, closed root and corrupt/stale geometry. These are explicitly not accepted seasonal checkpoints.
verification.validationOrder: Added after passing full npm suite for the surface/evaporation component. Four targeted first-spill tests, all-target compilation and warnings-denied clippy validate this additional static API; no existing physical function is modified.
limitations: All direct receiving branch/plateau alternatives retained with the existing canonical contact path, not all possible contact pairs or hydraulic optimal paths.
hasUniqueRoute is geometric cardinality, not permission to apply a spill.
Static descent stops at the actual wet contact or closed terminal, not an active merged reservoir.
No rate, travel time, recipient backpressure or conservative stock transfer is selected here.

nativeReport.scope: Static first-connection certificates for closed minimum leaves. Canonical sill passages followed by existing downhill receivers identify actual wet-body contacts or closed terminals. All alternatives retained; no water moves, no active neighboring capacity/backpressure is checked, no hydraulic time, allocation policy, merge or simulation checkpoint is created.
